svg.title: Explicit cross-corpus feature incidence
svg.desc: Positive authored feature assignments. Absence means not assigned, not logical negation. FEP rows are family unions; upstream rows are individually named result units. Hypothesis axes include stated premises and regimes, not a common proposition. Each authored coordinate has unit weight. Domain/carrier/premise groups with more coordinates contribute more potential mismatches; no hidden group normalization.
svg.text: Assigned = filled; absent = unassigned. Every coordinate has unit weight.
C01domain:algebra: finite sums, matrices, identities, and algebraic constructions; positive editorial mathematical context.
C02domain:analysis: real differentiation, integration, inequalities, and limits; positive editorial mathematical context.
C03domain:topology: compactness, closed feasible carriers, continuity, and weak convergence; positive editorial mathematical context.
C04domain:probability: normalized laws, kernels, independence, and stochastic evolution; positive editorial mathematical context.
C05domain:measure-theory: sigma-algebras, native measures, disintegration, and integration; positive editorial mathematical context.
C06domain:information-theory: entropy, relative entropy, information, and coding bounds; positive editorial mathematical context.
C07domain:statistics: estimation, scoring rules, concentration, and model evidence; positive editorial mathematical context.
C08domain:optimization: variational bounds, minimization, descent, and projection; positive editorial mathematical context.
C09domain:control: finite planning, feedback, decision rules, and policy recursion; positive editorial mathematical context.
C10domain:dynamical-systems: iterates, semigroups, stationarity, and convergence; positive editorial mathematical context.
C11domain:differential-geometry: Fisher pairings, coordinate pullbacks, and dual coordinates; positive editorial mathematical context.
C12domain:graph-theory: finite causal ordering, node divergence, and edge currents; positive editorial mathematical context.
C13domain:causal-inference: authored intervention mechanisms and conditional factorization; positive editorial mathematical context.
C14domain:thermodynamics: entropy-production and free-energy identities on explicit carriers; positive editorial mathematical context.
C15carrier:finite-discrete: A selected law, chain, message, policy or map has a finite discrete carrier; this is not inferred from finite storage of a continuous object.
C16carrier:finite-dimensional-real: The selected statement uses actual real scalar/vector/matrix data. This coordinate alone does not imply a smooth manifold or identifiable parameters.
C17carrier:general-measurable: Native sigma-algebras, measures, kernels or Borel laws are explicit objects in the selected contract, possibly together with finite carriers.
C18carrier:euclidean-space: An ambient Euclidean geometric carrier is explicitly used in the selected result, beyond real-valued scalar arithmetic.
C19carrier:function-space: The selected result quantifies over functions, trial laws, controls, or an infinite-dimensional normed carrier; no common Banach structure is implied.
C20carrier:metric-space: A declared metric/norm topology is part of the selected contract, with its own distance; this is not the MDS feature-space metric.
C21carrier:graph: A finite graph, node/edge carrier or graph-realization state is explicit; graphical conditional independence alone is insufficient.
C22carrier:path-space: Path laws, time-indexed protocols or progressively measurable controls are explicit; this does not identify a common physical path carrier.
C23hypothesis:normalization: A normalized law/kernel or a normalization condition/conclusion is explicit in the selected statement. It is not asserted to be a premise of every family theorem.
C24hypothesis:full-support: Strictly positive mass/density on the stated whole law carrier is explicit. Local selected support and positive evidence at one event do not suffice.
C25hypothesis:regularity: An explicit measurable, continuous, differentiable, completeness or analytic parameter regularity condition occurs; those distinct notions are not interchangeable.
C26hypothesis:convexity: Convex body, log-concavity or convex-potential curvature is explicit in the selected contract; no shared uniform convexity hypothesis is inferred.
C27hypothesis:compactness: A compact carrier/feasible set or its compactness-based attainment argument is explicit. Finite-dimensionality alone does not suffice.
C28hypothesis:independence: Independence, product-law structure or reversible conditional-factorization inputs occur explicitly. This does not identify empirical or causal independence.
C29hypothesis:finite-horizon: A fixed finite time/horizon or finite-time bound is part of the selected contract. It does not assert an infinite-horizon or stopping-time result.
C30hypothesis:asymptotic-limit: A convergence or dimension/system-size limit is a stated target or regime. Despite this coordinate group name it is not a logical hypothesis by itself.
F: family context unions · U: individually reviewed source result units
C: common domain / carrier / premise-or-regime coordinates; complete keys in HTML
Binary mismatches define squared Euclidean distance; no hidden learned weights.
